activities.label: Eye of the Storm
activities.text: Bonus action, once per long rest: a 60-foot radius on you for 1 minute (unseen without Chakra sense or sight). You know where every creature in it is; Laser Circus can target them, even behind Cover.

activities.label: Interference Field
activities.text: Hostile creatures in it, at the start of their turns. Failure: their Ninjutsu and Genjutsu without Lightning or Water Release cost 4 more until the start of their next turn.

rules.text: Grounded Surge: hostile creatures Shocked or Chilled on your turn save against your Ranton Hijutsu at −2.
[Reezaa Branch] Two Circuits (more at 7th and 15th): the option items. Refraction Point is the clan's condition.

activities.label: Cascade
activities.text: Once per turn, after you deal cold and lightning to it: until the end of your next turn, if it moves more than 5 feet willingly or casts a Mobility (M) jutsu, three times your Laser Circus damage.

activities.label: Cascade: stun
activities.text: Failure: Stunned until the end of its current turn.

rules.text: Once per turn, cold damage from your Water Release jutsu: water particles around the creature until the end of your next turn; your first missed Laser Circus against it can be rerolled. 7th: a Water jutsu that damages and can inflict an Elemental condition can mark it a Refraction Point for 1 minute instead, even on a success.

activities.label: Overload: 2+ hits
activities.text: Once per turn after your Action and Bonus action Laser Circus attacks, a creature hit twice or more. Failure: Dazed and Weakened.

activities.label: Overload: 3+ hits
activities.text: A 20-foot radius, 30-foot cone or 60 by 5-foot line from it. Failure: Bruised and Slowed.

activities.label: Overload: 5+ hits
activities.text: Failure: Stunned.

rules.text: One effect per turn.
A Laser Circus hit on a Refraction Point: the creatures its chain damages become Refraction Points for 1 minute.

activities.label: Rapid Fire: Laser Circus
activities.text: Bonus action, after Laser Circus attacks with the Attack action: one more (two at 7th, three at 15th).

activities.label: Static Arc
activities.text: Once per turn, Bonus action after you deal lightning damage: a creature you can see within 20 feet of the target. Failure: Shocked and a Refraction Point for 1 minute.

rules.text: [Reezaa Branch] Enter the Laser Circus chakra stance as a Bonus action (the clan's stance item: Laser Circus is its attack button).

activities.label: Laser Circus
activities.text: A creature you can see within 60 feet. An 8 or higher on the die: it is marked as a Refraction Point.

rules.text: [Reezaa Branch] The Attack action, or a Ranton Hijutsu that attacks, can swap any of its attacks for Laser Circus. Without Extra Attack: two at 7th, three at 15th.
After a long rest: you and up to 5 allies share a chakra network until your next long rest: talk within 1 mile; if one is Surprised, the others in the same initiative aren't.
[Storm Branch] Two Circuits (more at 7th and 15th): the option items, spending Voltage. Their saves use your highest jutsu save DC.

roll.note: Casting a Lightning or Water jutsu that summons: the summons gain hit points equal to your level and +1 AC (7th: +2 AC, resistance to earth and fire; 15th: +3 AC, immunity to Elemental conditions).

Once per turn on your turn: −10 remaining speed, teleport to a space you can see within 30 feet; the first attack on you from within 10 feet of it before your next turn has disadvantage. 7th: a melee attack right after has advantage.

activities.label: Grounded
activities.text: In Storm Force, up to 4 Voltage: until the end of the turn, lightning or cold ranged attacks at allies within 60 feet can target you instead; immunity to Shocked and Chilled.

activities.label: Shield of Thunder
activities.text: In Shield Form, once per turn, Reaction to damage from an attack: a lightning Barrier with these hit points until the end of the turn (11th: immune to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing).

activities.label: Spear of Heaven
activities.text: In Spear Form, once per turn, a melee Ninjutsu or Taijutsu attack dealing lightning. Failure: the damage and Dazed (7th: Staggered too); success: half. 15th: this and the attack's lightning ignore resistance and treat immunity as resistance.

roll.note: Bonus action: consume all Shocked from creatures within 30 feet; 1d4 temporary chakra per rank until the end of your next turn (roll them).

activities.label: Storm Drain: dispel (7th)
activities.text: A hostile creature in range with a beneficial Lightning Release jutsu (any nature release at 15th). Failure: it's dispelled.

roll.note: 1 per trigger per turn: a hostile creature damages you, you deal lightning damage to a hostile creature, or you succeed on a save against a hostile effect.

rules.text: [Storm Branch] Entering initiative: the Storm Force state in Spear or Shield form until combat ends (swap as a Bonus action; the two option items have the buttons). Voltage: up to 4 (5 at 7th, 6 at 15th), the pool; 0 at the start and end of combat.

activities.label: Shield Form
activities.text: Until combat ends (or you swap): resistance to lightning.

activities.label: Shield Form: start of turn
activities.text: At the start of each of your turns.

activities.label: Shield Form: Lightning or Water jutsu
activities.text: Casting a Lightning or Water jutsu on a turn you gained them, up to twice a turn.

activities.label: Spear Form
activities.text: Until combat ends (or you swap): your unarmed and weapon attacks can deal lightning; melee attacks from your Hijutsu +1 to hit and +2 damage (7th: unarmed and weapon lightning attacks too; 15th: +2 and +4; add them).

activities.label: Black Lightning
activities.text: For the duration your jutsu can't have their cost raised by hostile effects; concentration jutsu gain Stable or Efficient (pick); an Overcharge can cost 2 more instead of the Bonus action.

activities.label: Mirrors and Lights: first volley
